description: This Java class implements the RetrieveAttributesStrategy, which handles the RetrieveAttributes command in a persistence context. It extracts attributes from a Thing object, constructs JSON responses, and manages entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the RetrieveAttributes command, extracting attributes from a Thing and generating appropriate results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to retrieve attributes from a Thing, returning a Result containing a ThingEvent or an error.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Extracts Attributes from a given Thing, throwing if the entity is not found.

methods.name: getAttributesJson
methods.description: Converts Attributes to JSON, optionally selecting specific fields based on the command.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous EntityTag for the given RetrieveAttributes command and previous entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next EntityTag from the new entity's attributes.
